stemMd: A town grants an exemption to a household if every resident is over seventy. It never grants an exemption to a household containing a wage earner. Which household shows that these two rules cannot both be followed in every case?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A household with one sixty-year-old pensioner.

options.label: B
options.textMd: A household containing a forty-year-old wage earner.

options.label: C
options.textMd: A household with no resident over seventy and no wage earner.

options.label: D
options.textMd: A household whose only resident is a seventy-five-year-old wage earner.

options.label: E
options.textMd: A household of two eighty-year-old residents with no wage income.

explanationMd: Find a case satisfying both the entitlement trigger and the prohibition trigger. The older wage earner requires the town both to grant and to withhold the exemption. Other cases do not force contradictory actions.

distractorRationale.a: Neither rule compels opposing outcomes here.
